title: A Second-Order Monolithic Scheme for the Coupled Stokes--Biot Model Using Total Pressure
summary: We develop and analyze a second-order, fully implicit, monolithic time-discretization for the coupled time-dependent Stokes and quasi-static Biot system. The Biot subsystem is formulated in a three-field total-pressure formulation, in which the total pressure is introduced as an additional unknown together with the solid displacement and pore pressure. This reformulation improves robustness in nearly incompressible regimes and suppresses volumetric locking. All variables are discretized in time using the BDF2 scheme, and the coupled problem is solved monolithically without operator…
